# pve_ceph_health_mute (Action)

Mute or unmute one Ceph health check.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_ceph_health_mute" "example" {
  config {
    code  = "CHANGE_ME"
    value = true
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_ceph_health_mute.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String) The health check to mute, as reported by 'ceph health', for example 'AUTH_INSECURE_CLIENT_KEY_TYPE'.
- `value` (Boolean) Whether to mute (true) or unmute (false) the check.

### Optional

- `sticky` (Boolean) Keep the mute even when the check gets worse. Without this a mute clears itself as soon as the number of affected items grows, which brings the check back to attention. Only used when muting. (default: 0)
- `ttl` (String) How long the mute lasts, for example '2h', '3d' or '1w'. Without it the mute has no expiry. Only used when muting.
